title: Mirror Tempest Gate: Ascension Seal
description: Mirror Tempest Gate unfolds across tempest mirror gate where false lanes split from sacred ground, pushing a one active deity Kami deity to prove precise control, repositioning, evasion, spirit terrain, disciplined burst. without violating established Realm canon.
